    json.dump(receipt, output, indent=2)
    output.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt))
print((root/'stdout.log').read_text()[-7000:])

raise SystemExit(result.returncode or int(not receipt['inputs_unchanged']) or int(receipt['skipped'] > 0) or int(receipt['tests']!=planned_cases) or int(new_descendants!=0) or int(resources['sampling_errors']!=0))
